method_card.title: School Subjects and the School Day
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school subject vocabulary, giving opinions with reasons, telling the time, and describing your timetable.

FrenchEnglish
le françaisFrench
les mathsmaths
les sciencesscience
l'histoirehistory
la géographiegeography
l'informatiquecomputer science
la musiquemusic
l'EPSPE
le dessin / l'artart
intéressant(e)interesting
ennuyeux / ennuyeuseboring
utileuseful
difficiledifficult
facileeasy
passionnant(e) (Higher)exciting / fascinating
l'emploi du tempstimetable

Opinions with reasons: Use Ma matière préférée, c'est… + parce que or car + reason. Je suis fort(e) en… = I am good at. Je suis nul(le) en… = I am rubbish at. These opinion structures earn marks in speaking and writing tasks.

Telling the time: Il est huit heures (8:00), et quart (quarter past), et demie (half past), moins le quart (quarter to). À midi = at noon. Timetables use 24-hour time in France: Il est treize heures (1 pm).

Adjective agreement: Adjectives must agree with the noun: les leçons intéressantes (f pl), le cours ennuyeux (m sg). Watch the feminine: ennuyeux → ennuyeuse, passionnant → passionnante.

Model: Ma matière préférée, c'est les sciences parce que je trouve les cours passionnants. Cependant, je suis nulle en maths car c'est trop difficile pour moi. Le lundi, les leçons commencent à huit heures trente. (My favourite subject is science because I find the lessons exciting. However, I am rubbish at maths because it is too difficult for me. On Mondays, lessons start at 8:30.)
steps: Learn the school subjects in French with their genders
Use varied opinion phrases beyond j'aime and je n'aime pas
Always give a reason with parce que or car
Master adjective agreement with subject nouns (feminine and plural forms)
Practise telling the time and describing your timetable

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — school timetable appears in listening tasks, opinions in speaking and writing

worked_examples.question: Translate: 'Ma matière préférée c'est l'anglais parce que je trouve les leçons intéressantes.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Ma matière préférée c'est = My favourite subject is.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: je trouve les leçons intéressantes = I find the lessons interesting. Note: intéressantes is feminine plural to agree with les leçons.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: My favourite subject is English because I find the lessons interesting.

worked_examples.question: How do you tell the time in French?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with Il est + number + heure(s): Il est huit heures = It is 8 o'clock.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Quarter past: et quart. Half past: et demie. Quarter to: moins le quart.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: 24-hour time: Il est treize heures quinze = 1:15 pm. French schools use 24-hour time in timetables.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Il est + number + heure(s). Add et quart, et demie, or moins le quart for quarter-hour times.

bronze.question: Match the French school subjects to the English meaning
Match the French opinion words to the English meaning
Complete the opinion sentence with the correct words

gaps.correct_explain: préférée agrees with matière (feminine). Ma matière préférée = my favourite subject.

wrong.préféré: préféré is masculine. Matière is feminine — use préférée with an extra e.

gaps.correct_explain: parce que = because. Used to give a reason after an opinion.
intéressantes is feminine plural to agree with les leçons (f pl).

wrong.intéressant: intéressant is masculine singular. Les leçons is feminine plural — you need intéressantes.

gaps.correct_explain: Any reasonable start time works. neuf = nine. À neuf heures = at nine o'clock.
finissent is the elles/ils form of finir. Les leçons finissent = the lessons finish.

wrong.finit: finit is the il/elle singular form. Les leçons is plural — use finissent.

bronze.question: What does 'Je suis nul en maths car c'est trop difficile pour moi' mean?
options: I am rubbish at maths because it is too difficult for me
I am good at maths because it is easy for me
I don't like maths because the teacher is strict
I study maths because it is important

bronze.question: What time is 'Il est neuf heures et quart'?

bronze.source_text: J'adore les sciences parce que c'est utile. Cependant, je déteste la géographie car c'est ennuyeux.
model_answers: I love science because it is useful. However, I hate geography because it is boring.

wrong.bon: bon is possible but fort(e) is the more natural expression for school subjects.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Le prof de français est sympa mais la prof de maths est strict.
silver.explanation: la prof is feminine, so the adjective must be in the feminine form: stricte (not strict).
silver.translation: The French teacher is nice but the maths teacher is strict.

silver.question: Build the sentence in French
silver.english: I study twelve subjects at my school.

distractor_labels.ma: wrong gender — collège is masculine, needs mon not ma

silver.source_text: I love English because I find the lessons interesting. However, I am rubbish at maths.
model_answers: J'adore l'anglais parce que je trouve les leçons intéressantes. Cependant, je suis nul(le) en maths.
hints: I am rubbish at = je suis nul(le) en

gold.source_text: My school has about eight hundred pupils. My favourite subject is science because I find the lessons exciting. However, I am rubbish at maths because it is too difficult. The maths teacher gives too much homework.
model_answers: Mon collège a environ huit cents élèves. Ma matière préférée c'est les sciences parce que je trouve les cours passionnants. Cependant, je suis nul(le) en maths car c'est trop difficile. Le prof de maths donne trop de devoirs.

gold.question: Build the sentence in French
gold.english: The subject I like the most is music because it is exciting.

distractor_labels.les: wrong article — matière is singular feminine, needs la not les
distractor_labels.passionnante: wrong agreement — after c'est, the adjective takes the default masculine form: passionnant

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in France. A French student asks you about your school and timetable.

bullets.prompt: Describe your school — say how many pupils there are and what type of school it is.
bullets.model_answer: Mon collège est mixte et il y a environ neuf cents élèves. C'est un grand collège.
bullets.note: il y a + number + élèves; un collège mixte = a mixed-sex school

bullets.prompt: Say which subject you like most and give a reason.
bullets.model_answer: Ma matière préférée c'est l'anglais parce que je trouve les leçons intéressantes et le prof est sympa.
bullets.note: ma matière préférée + parce que + adjective agreement (intéressantes f pl)

bullets.prompt: Say which subject you dislike and explain why.
bullets.model_answer: Je déteste les maths car c'est trop difficile pour moi. Je suis nul(le) en maths.
bullets.note: je déteste + car + reason; je suis nul(le) en + subject

bullets.prompt: Describe your timetable — say when lessons start and when lunch is.
bullets.model_answer: Les leçons commencent à huit heures et demie. La pause-déjeuner est à midi.
bullets.note: telling the time: à + heures + et demie; la pause-déjeuner = lunch break
